description: A modal window that opens as a centered dialog on desktop and a bottom drawer on mobile.
overview:
`Modal` presents focused content that blocks the rest of the page, such as a form or a share sheet. On desktop it renders a `Dialog`. Below the `48rem` breakpoint it renders a bottom `Drawer` with a swipe handle, and each part switches to its drawer counterpart: the header, title, description and close map to the drawer's parts, `ModalBody` gains padding, and `ModalFooter` stacks its buttons in reverse order so the primary action sits on top.

Use it for tasks that need the user's full attention before returning to the page.
usage: The modal can be controlled with `open` and `onOpenChange` or uncontrolled with `defaultOpen`. Pass `render` to `ModalTrigger` or `ModalClose` to use your own `Button`. `ModalContent` shows a close button by default; set `showCloseButton` to `false` to hide it, or pass `closeLabel` to show text instead of the icon.

examples.WithCloseButton: Relies on the default corner close button as the only way to dismiss besides `Escape`.
examples.WithCloseLabel: Replaces the close icon with a text button using `closeLabel`.
examples.Floating: Insets the mobile drawer from the screen edges with `floating`.

parts.Modal: The root that renders a `Dialog` on desktop and a `Drawer` on mobile.
parts.ModalTrigger: The button that opens the modal.
parts.ModalContent: The popup window, with a close button by default.
parts.ModalBody: The main content area, padded on mobile.
parts.ModalFooter: Holds the modal's actions; stacked with the primary action on top on mobile.
parts.ModalTitle: The modal's title, used as its accessible name.
parts.ModalDescription: Supporting text, used as the modal's accessible description.
parts.ModalClose: A button that closes the modal.

Modal.onOpenChange: Called when the modal opens or closes.
Modal.floating: Insets the mobile drawer from the screen edges with fully rounded corners.

ModalContent.className: Classes applied to the dialog or drawer popup.
ModalContent.style: Inline styles applied to the dialog or drawer popup.

accessibility:
- The popup has the `dialog` role, named by `ModalTitle` and described by `ModalDescription`.
- `Escape` closes the modal and returns focus to the trigger.
- The default close button is labelled Close.
notes: Parts carry `data-slot` values from `modal` through `modal-close`. `ModalContent` accepts `className` and `style` as plain values only, because the same props are forwarded to either the dialog or the drawer popup.
